subject: Discovery recap: buying committee, procurement timeline & security deliverables
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastmedhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: buying committee, procurement timeline & security deliverables

Alex / team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we have a shared picture and clear next steps.

Attendees (on our side): Laura Bennett (AE), Ben Carter (SE)
Attendees (FastMed): Alex Johnson (Head of ML)

High-level buying committee (captured on the call):
- Economic buyer: Sarah Lee (CFO) — will sign off on budget
- Technical champion: Alex Johnson (Head of ML) — driving eval and PoC
- Procurement lead: Maria Gonzales (Procurement Director) — commercial/PO
- Legal / InfoSec reviewer: Tom Rivera (GC) — contract & evidence review

Decision criteria (what you said matters most):
- Latency & predictable throughput for peak clinic hours
- Data isolation and retention controls for PHI-adjacent logs
- Clear cost profile (40–100m tokens/mo) and discounting for committed capacity
- Security evidence (SOC 2 Type II + pen test summary + audit logs access)

Proposed timeline:
- Procurement window opens: Oct 6
- Legal review + evidence intake: Oct 7–13
- Exec sign-off (CFO): target by Oct 20

Action items (owner / due):
1) Share security/evidence bundle (SOC2 exec summary, pen test summary, audit log answers) — owner: Marissa Cole — target: Oct 5 EOD
2) Provide short price/commitment options and a 6-month PoC quote — owner: Ben Carter — target: Oct 6
3) Schedule legal/procurement deep dive (30–45m) with Tom & Maria — owner: Laura Bennett — propose Oct 7
4) Draft mutual action plan (MAP) showing milestones and acceptance criteria for PoC — owner: Laura / Alex — target: Oct 8

Notes on evidence: we can share a SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA/secure link; pen test executive summary is available and redacted for vendor details; audit-log access can be demonstrated via a sample export and retention policy statement. Marissa, will you drop the files to the secure link and summarize the key answers to the four questions Alex raised?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for Oct 7 unless I hear conflicts.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastmedhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@fastmedhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: buying committee, procurement timeline & security deliverables

Laura — thanks for the thorough recap. Confirming our timeline and adding a couple items from procurement/legal:

Procurement timeline: Maria (cc) will consolidate vendor evaluations and target issuing an RFP shortlist by Oct 14. Final PO target Oct 20 (tight).

Legal / Security asks to cover in the initial packet:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Pen test executive summary (high-level findings + remediation status)
- Answers on audit log retention (how long we can access logs tied to requests and configuration)
- Encryption, tenant isolation, and access control overview

Tom Rivera (GC) will lead contract redlines; looping him in now: tom.rivera@fastmedhealth.com. Sarah Lee (CFO) will be engaged if cost or term exceptions are requested.

If you can get the evidence bundle by EOD Oct 5 that will give us a head start for the legal review. Also, Ben — please include a short pricing sheet (1 page) for a 6-month committed pool vs. on-demand consumption.

I’ll be available for the Oct 7 slot; Maria will confirm after syncing with Tom and Sarah.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of ML | FastMed Health
alex.johnson@fastmedhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastmedhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: buying committee, procurement timeline & security deliverables

Alex / team — attaching the initial evidence bundle here (secure share link below). Files are redacted for vendor detail where appropriate; happy to provide full reports under an NDA/secure portal.

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2-Redwood-2025-Q4-summary.pdf (stub) — executive summary and controls matrix
- pen-test-exec-summary.pdf (stub) — high-level findings and closure status
- audit-logs-sla.txt (stub) — retention windows and access process

Quick answers to the specific asks you listed:
1) SOC 2 Type II: We have a Type II from 2025 Q4. Executive summary attached; full report available via signed NDA and secure portal (https://secure.redwood.com/share/abc123).
2) Pen test: Executive summary attached. No critical open findings; medium findings are being tracked and remediation ETA is 2026-11-10. We can provide a redacted findings list if you need more detail for legal.
3) Audit logs / retention: Default retention for request logs (interaction tokens, request metadata) is 30 days. We offer extended retention tiers (90 days, 1 year) as a managed option for Dedicated/Private deployments — pricing differs. Exports can be provided as CSV with hashes for integrity; API access for log queries can be scoped to roles.
4) Encryption & isolation: All customer data in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). For Private/Dedicated we provide tenant isolation and customer-controlled KMS integration (HSM options available).

Next steps we can own from security side:
- Provide full SOC2 under NDA (Marissa) — target share: Oct 6 via secure portal
- Provide redacted pen-test details for Tom (if he wants deeper read) — target: Oct 6
- Joint legal/procurement call prep: I can join Oct 7 to walk through evidence and answer controls questions (30 min)

If you’d like a one-pager that maps our controls to common procurement checklists (e.g., CSV for your intake form), we can generate that overnight.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastmedhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@fastmedhealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@fastmedhealth.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fastmedhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: buying committee, procurement timeline & security deliverables

Received, thanks Marissa — that portal link should work for initial review. Maria / Tom / Sarah — please expect the SOC2 executive summary and pen-test summary from Redwood today; these will feed the legal checklist.

We’re aiming to get procurement/legal comments back by Oct 13. Ben — please send the 1-page pricing matrix when you can; we’ll use that to brief Sarah.

Tentative: schedule the joint legal/procurement deep-dive for Wed Oct 7 at 10:00am PT — Maria will confirm. If that works for Redwood security (Marissa) and Laura/Ben, go ahead and send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Alex
